description:
Unleash your adventurous spirit with the Tornado Fat Tire E-Bike - your ultimate all-terrain vehicle! Its powerful 750W peak motor and robust 26x4 inch tires ensure an exhilarating ride on any surface, granting superior traction and control, whether it's snow, sand, rocky paths, or mountains. The bike's 48V 14Ah battery delivers up to 45 miles per charge, and a built-in USB port lets you recharge your phone on the go. Conquer every terrain, and indulge in the thrill - seize the all-terrain riding experience with the Tornado Fat Tire E-Bike!
The Tornado Step Thru fat tire electric bike is powered by a 48V 14Ah lithium-ion battery that will allow you to ride 45 miles on a single charge without assistance. With a USB charging port, you can charge your phone anytime.
The 750w power peak makes it possible to accelerate faster and get through obstacles effortlessly. It delivers smooth power transfer packs enough punch to tackle off-road trails with steep inclines.
The sturdy fat tires are laced to wide rims and even wider hubs, making them stiff and enhancing the tires' grip. The big tires enable the e-bike to be an all-season bike. You can ride on snow, sand, mud, dirt, gravel, rocks, pavement, etc.
6-speed Gear Shift System
You can shift to a larger cog for uphill and downshift to a smaller cog at high speed with the 6-speed freewheel. Choosing the suitable freewheel under the different riding conditions will improve efficiency.
Durable Removable Rear Rack
This rear rack with 55 lb capacity is specially designed for Tornado Step Thru fat tire ebike. It is built to take your adventures to the next level. You can haul your essential items on the next trip whether it is to the office or the woods.
Sensitive Twist Throttle
When you want exercise by pedaling, just enjoy the ride with no power. When tired, you can power the throttle to get more motor assistance and greater acceleration and get back home.
Extra Large Comfortable Saddle
The wide and ergonomic seat allows any person to ride pleasantly avoiding possible problems with the butt and back, while a large layer of padding helps to further increase the feeling of comfort in every situation.
USB Charging Port
When your phone runs out of power, you are able to recharge it with the USB on the battery anywhere.
Lockable Front Suspension
The suspension fork provides extra comfort when riding over broken pavement or fire road and doubletrack-type trails.
Digital Multi-functional Display
LED backlight display is an intelligent butler that records your riding statistics. It shows important operating information like speed, mileage, battery capacity, timing, etc.
Durable PVC Full Fenders
You can take your bike anywhere and don't need to worry about the elements underneath your tires, such as water and mud.
Mechanical Disc Brakes
Both the front and rear 160mm mechanical disc brakes provide ample stopping power even in the harshest condition.
